snippet.title: ForMind — Underwater Survival Horror | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 *Play the ForMind Demo on Steam* - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765390/ForMind_Demo/

⚠️ *Wishlist ForMind on Steam* - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680770/ForMind/

ForMind is a third-person survival horror shooter with RPG elements, set inside a collapsing underwater research complex.

Face intelligent monsters that adapt to your actions, set ambushes and play dead. Use limited resources, traps and the environment to survive and uncover the secrets of the Zirotech station.

The ForMind Demo is available now on PC via Steam. The full game is coming in Q1 2027.
